title: SAP Analytics Cloud Story Load Time p95
app: SAP Analytics Cloud audit and activity exports via the SAC API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=sac:audit status="Success"
| eval dur_s=round(duration_ms/1000,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by story_name
| where p95_s>10
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile load time for each story in SAP Analytics Cloud and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking SAP Analytics Cloud storys by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest SAP Analytics Cloud timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest storys with their owners.
visualization: Table of story by p95 load time, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in SAP Analytics Cloud so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
